reviews.text: Mandy and Tarah are THE BEST! From beginning to end they have been extremely communicative. We were in the Sanger hail storm, and our roof was messed up. Previously, we had another company that we thought would help, but they didn't, and we decided to leave them and they threatened to sue (HCO construction DO NOT do business with them). Tarah immediately eased our minds and advised us through that issue. She even gave us her own written letter to give to them since we were NOT binned to any contract with the previous company. After that mess, they got to work right away. Everything was done very quickly and we had a new roof! Jesse and his crew were amazing as well. Very punctual and very thoughtful. They made sure everything was clean and neat before they left. I HIGHLY recommend Mandy, Tarah and Jesse. They were amazing and I will be using them for any roofing needs from here on out.
reviews.author: Randon-lee Ramos-Sheldon

reviews.text: HomePro Roofing did an excellent job on my roof. Craig was great to work with. Very patient and always helpful with decisions. He also was able to get insurance to pay for my roof as it was denied by previous claim.  The roofing crew was very professional and knowledgeable. The entire team was courteous and very respectful. They did a great job and cleaned up and completed job in less than one day!  Highly recommended!!!  Thank you all.
reviews.author: Inf Harris

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Home Pro. Craig was professional, responsive and communicated with integrity. State Farm was initially difficult to work with but Craig was persistent and got out roof approved. I would highly recommend that you call Craig at Home Pro if you are in need of a high quality roof. The roof and installation process exceeded my expectations.
reviews.author: Ricky D

reviews.text: Home Pro did an excellent job on our house. Mandy was awesome to work with. Tera as well. Great help, great customer service, and even better communication. 5 stars isn’t enough! Would recommend Home Pro to anyone! Thanks again!
reviews.author: Shane Wolven

reviews.text: My wife and I just moved into our new home when we had a hail storm hit.  Being first time home owners this was all new to us. Mandy and Jesse were tremendous in walking us through the process. They were always available and answered every question we had along the way. I hope we dont have a storm hit us like that again, but if one does i will make sure and make Mandy is my first call
reviews.author: Alex Nieto

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

HomePro Roofing and Restoration did an excellent job on our roof replacement! From the very beginning, working with Mandy Mendoza was a great experience—he provided us with all the information and tools we needed to confidently move forward with their company. The entire process was smooth and professional, and we were especially impressed with the quick turnaround—they replaced our roof in just one day! We are very happy with the results so far and would highly recommend HomePro Roofing and Restoration to anyone in need of quality roofing work.
reviews.author: Michelle Sowell

reviews.text: Mandy was great at moving the claims process along. He was very easy to communicate with and was in touch with us all along the way. I appreciate the care the roofing crew took to protect plants and shrubs and the. Immaculate clean up all around the house. Very professional! The roof looks well done and we're very pleased.
reviews.author: Susan Gilbert

reviews.text: Darrel Dix answered all my questions, met with adjusters, kept me informed with the details and options, and provided timely services. Eric the crew supervisor interacted with Darrel the roofers and me to assure a professional job. Great teamwork Homepro. You lived up to your name.
reviews.author: Aubrey Fryar

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with specific details, employee names, and realistic customer stories. The consistent high ratings across platforms and detailed positive experiences suggest genuine quality service. The lack of negative reviews in the sample is notable but not definitive evidence of manipulation given the detailed authenticity of the positive reviews.
fake_signals: Limited review volume (64 Google, 22 Yelp) for a 4-year-old company
All sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback

positive_evidence: Crew took care to protect plants

authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Mandy, Tarah, Craig, Jesse, Darrel, Eric)
Detailed project narratives (hail damage, insurance claims, one-day installation)
Varied writing styles and specific customer situations
Mention of resolving issues with other contractors and insurance companies
complaint_patterns: Threats from previous contractor (mentioned in review, not about HomePro)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (4.9) and Yelp (4.8). BBB rating is A+ with no complaints listed, which aligns with positive customer feedback. No contradictory low ratings found.
